hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: Three decades of experience in excellent furniture

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Jaime Mendes has been working with furniture since the age of 12. It all began in his grandfather's family business, which passed on a passion for wood and carpentry — working with wood is making art, transforming what people imagine into something real and tangible.
story.paragraph2: The <brand>J. Mendes Mobiliário</brand> was born from a personal pursuit: a 50m² space, a panel saw and a copying machine, where most of the work was done by hand. With modest means, but the same essence and honesty that defines us to this day, we kept growing.
story.paragraph3: Today our furniture factory is equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and a team of young craftspeople trained by the founder himself — to whom he passed on not just technical knowledge, but a genuine love for carpentry.
story.imageAlt1: Image from the history of J. Mendes Furniture
story.imageAlt2: Image of the J. Mendes Furniture team
story.paragraph4: Focused on all types of furniture — from residential projects to collaborations with architects — we continue to bring the dreams of those who seek us to life.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: How we handle your personal data
Privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to J. Mendes Mobiliário. This policy explains what personal data we collect, for what purposes and what your rights are under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: Personal data collected through this website is processed by J. Mendes Mobiliário, located at Praça 20 de maio, 39, 4590-182 Paços de Ferreira, Portugal. For any data protection matter, contact us at geral@jaimemendes.com or +351 255 873 030.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: We collect the data you voluntarily provide through the contact form — name, email address, phone number (if provided) and the content of your message. We also collect technical data strictly necessary for the website to function, such as your language preference.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis
sections.body: We use your data to respond to your contact and quote requests and to manage the resulting relationship. The legal basis is the performance of pre-contractual steps at your request and our legitimate interest in replying to you. Technical site data relies on our legitimate interest in ensuring its proper operation.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses only strictly necessary cookies for its operation (such as remembering your language), which do not require consent. We do not currently use analytics or marketing cookies. Should we introduce them, we will request your prior consent.

sections.heading: Data sharing and processors
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. To provide the service we rely on providers that process data on our behalf with appropriate safeguards: Brevo (sending contact-form emails), Sanity (content management) and Vercel (website hosting). These providers may process data on servers located inside or outside the European Economic Area, always with adequate legal safeguards.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your data only for as long as necessary to respond to your request and to comply with any legal obligations. After that period, data is deleted or anonymised.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: As a data subject, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict or object to the processing of your data, as well as the right to data portability. To exercise these rights, contact us at geral@jaimemendes.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese Data Protection Authority (CNPD).

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: We adopt appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, loss or disclosure.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page, together with its update date.

Cookie.message: This website only uses cookies that are essential to its operation.

intro.title: How it works
intro.paragraph1: We work by project: a kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom, a whole house or a commercial space.
intro.paragraph2: The more you tell us, the more accurate the quote. If you have plans, measurements, drawings or photos of the space, attach them to your request.
intro.step1: 1. We receive your request and review the project.
intro.step2: 2. We send the quote and, if needed, drawings for approval.
intro.step3: 3. Once the order is confirmed, production begins.
